description: This file defines the class TestPassAuthenticator, which extends TestFailAuthenticator, providing an implementation of user authentication that always returns true, and a method to check if the authenticator is enabled.

classes.name: TestPassAuthenticator
classes.description: A class extending TestFailAuthenticator that implements a pass-through authentication always returning true.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user given username, password, and service auth indicator; always returns true.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the authenticator is not enabled.
